lines.say: Five facts about penguins you probably didn't know.
lines.caption: 5 facts
lines.cap: Five facts about penguins you probably didn't know.

lines.say: One. Emperor penguins can dive more than five hundred meters deep.
lines.caption: Deep divers
lines.cap: One. Emperor penguins can dive more than 500 meters deep.

lines.say: Two. Their tuxedo is camouflage: dark from above, bright from below.
lines.caption: Camouflage
lines.cap: Two. Their tuxedo is camouflage: dark from above, bright from below.

lines.say: Three. They can drink seawater. A gland filters out the salt, and it drips from their nose.
lines.caption: Salt water
lines.cap: Three. They can drink seawater. A gland filters out the salt, and it drips from their nose.

lines.say: Four. Emperor dads keep the egg on their feet for two months, without eating.
lines.caption: Egg on feet
lines.cap: Four. Emperor dads keep the egg on their feet for two months, without eating.

lines.say: Five. No penguins live in the Arctic. They're almost all in the south.
lines.caption: South only
lines.cap: Five. No penguins live in the Arctic. They're almost all in the south.
